verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's memory docs say the assistant remembers by writing plain Markdown files to the agent's workspace (default `~/.openclaw/workspace`) on a self-hosted gateway, and that the model only remembers what is saved to disk. That makes the memory store local and open-format. Because the files are plain Markdown, users can inspect, edit, or delete them directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of first-party memory inspect/edit/delete commands or UI, clarity on whether SQLite-backed session history is equally user-editable, independent or hands-on corroboration.
